title: Inside the Loop.
old_caption: Leo won't leave the Loop. Sag will drive anywhere. Pisces has been circling the Beltway looking for its exit the entire video. Inside or outside the Loop?

title: Museum District first date
old_caption: Aquarius loves a blank canvas. Virgo is now sweating over whether that means Aquarius is about nothing. The tour guide star just wants everyone to skip the guessing. Who's your museum date sign?

title: Every culture. One city.
old_caption: Hola, ni hao, namaste, salut, xin chao, ahlan, hello. The big star over Houston tried to say hi in every language and got as far as 'xin ch... hi.' How do you say hi?

title: Houston, we have a problem
old_caption: Mission Control detected heavy swiping, a thumb at escape velocity and one very dizzy star. One slam on ABORT later, there's a new flight plan. Houston, are you swiping in circles too?

title: Rodeo season
old_caption: Rodeo season: suddenly everyone's a cowboy, price tags still on the hats. Sagittarius is the only one here who is actually half horse and would like you to know it.

title: They call it Space City.
old_caption: Space City, and dating here still feels Earth-bound. Pisces has cried into its space helmet so much there's a fish living in it now. It made a friend. Ready for liftoff, or still swiping in orbit?

title: Houston is huge
old_caption: Katy? Pearland? The Woodlands? The star searched the whole city with a magnifying glass, got sweaty, and flopped. Then it looked up. Which part of town are you searching?

title: You can barely see the stars.
old_caption: The one star you can see through the Houston haze tried to say hi and got called a plane. It is not a plane. So it blew the haze away, and all twelve were up there the whole time.

title: Houston has taste
old_caption: Taco: 10. Kolache: 10. Crawfish: 11. Taurus takes food very seriously, and points out you'd never pick a taco by its photo. Then the kolache lands on Taurus's head. What's your perfect 10?

title: An hour on the Katy Freeway…
old_caption: One hour on the Katy Freeway, honking the whole way, all for a date whose entire message was 'hey.' All four tires went flat out of sheer disappointment. Worth the drive?
